snippet.title: Broken Shell - Trailer
snippet.description: Broken Shell is a cozy point-and-click adventure game that beautifully tells the heartwarming story of two hermit crabs, Mr. & Mrs. Hermit. The journey is narrated through hand-drawn paintings and detailed animations, all without a single word. Broken Shell invites players of all ages to engage in a delightful experience filled with challenging puzzles, entertaining mini-games, and encounters with diverse characters. We believe it aligns with your vision and audience.
